children.text: The People overview uses Heterogeneity to display both Employees and Freelancers. This heterogeneous data is also visible in the relationship binding on the Team form. Via a sub menu structure, the two types can also be listed separately.
The Heterogeneity is modeled with Combination Modeling based on a common Document Model Person_Dc adding the special Fields for Employees and Freelancers via an Addition Step.

props.html:
The People overview uses Heterogeneity to display both Employees and Freelancers. This heterogeneous data is also visible in the relationship binding on the Team form. Via a sub menu structure, the two types can also be listed separately.

The Heterogeneity is modeled with Combination Modeling based on a common Document Model Person_Dc adding the special Fields for Employees and Freelancers via an Addition Step.

children.text: Different types of relationships are present: 1:n (City - People), self-referencing n:n (Team - Subteam), n:n with Additional Link Fields (Team - People) and other n:n relationships.

props.label:
There is a special Access Right "MODEL_MANAGE", that allows a Role to add, change or read models even if the Role is not listed in the model. 
This Access Right is assigned to the Roles "modeler" and "systemAdmin". Hence, these Roles (and the Users "ba" and "admin") can work with the models although they are not  listed in the model files.
